guards.rationale: Re-verdicted from waiver by the 2026-07-26 fix pass along with N1; this entry describes no divergence of its own, so it carries no verdict weight -- N1 and AfterObtained own the gap. Kept because both halves are still wanted. (a) THE FIX: `def after_obtained(self, run): run.add_potion_slots(self.POTION_SLOTS)` with POTION_SLOTS = 2 from `DynamicVar('PotionSlots', 2m)` (PotionBelt.cs:17) -- the pinned non-ascension value, no `AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension` anywhere in the file. It does NOT also need an `undo_after_obtained`: per PROMPT.md v6 item 3 the absence of that helper is faithful at every site because nothing in the game un-picks a relic; the conformance runner's relic swap (sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py:478-508, `_reconcile_node_relics`, `undo_after_obtained` call at :504) leaking two slots is a TOOLING defect to fix in the runner (default no-op at relics/base.py:206-212), and the mango/pear family shows what happens when an undo is written to clamp instead of subtract (see relic/pear). (b) THE EXECUTED NEGATIVE (binding rule 5): belt capacity decides whether a procure SUCCEEDS, since both `Player.AddPotionInternal` and `RunState.add_potion_slots` (sts2_rl/run.py:870-876) fail silently on a full belt, and relic/belt_buckle's Dexterity turns on whether the belt is EMPTY -- but not on whether it is full, so a missing slot cannot change Belt Buckle's 2 Dexterity by itself. I could not construct a ported chain from the missing slots to a combat number and none is claimed; the nearest exposure is that a full belt drops relic/petrified_toad's per-combat rock, which changes the belt and nothing else. That is why the gap is graded B (state divergence, belt only) and not A.
